data.one_liner: Flutter widget that automatically resizes text to fit within its bounds.
data.what_it_does: AutoSizeText behaves like a standard Text widget, but automatically adjusts the font size to fit perfectly within its constraints. It supports minimum and maximum font sizes, group synchronization, preset font sizes, and rich text.
use_when: You need text to shrink to fit a specific container without overflowing
You want to synchronize the font size across multiple text widgets
You need rich text formatting with automatic resizing capabilities
avoid_when: The text widget is placed inside unconstrained parents like a plain Row or Column without proper layout wrappers like Expanded
You do not need dynamic resizing and standard Text widgets suffice
strengths: Seamless drop-in replacement for standard Text and Text.rich widgets
Supports synchronizing multiple text sizes via AutoSizeGroup
Performs well and offers extensive parameter control like stepGranularity and presetFontSizes
weaknesses: Requires proper bounded constraints to calculate scaling properly, which can cause overflow if improperly wrapped

alternatives.name: auto_size_text
alternatives.why_pick_it: The original package version if you prefer it over the plus variant.

data.minimal_example:
AutoSizeText(
  'The text to display',
  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20),
  maxLines: 2,
)
